1.explanation: 1. We import the Carbon Toggle and its CSS. 2. In example #1 we set hideLabel=true but omit aria-labelledby, so you’ll see the labelText appear at the side instead of fully hiding. 3. In example #2 we add aria-labelledby on the Toggle that points to an external <label>, which hides the built-in label as intended. 4. Example #3 shows hideLabel=false, rendering the labelText above the control. This reproduces the bug described in the report.
1.bug_scenario: When using the Carbon Toggle component with hideLabel={true} but without also setting aria-labelledby, the label isn’t actually hidden—it’s merely moved to the side of the switch. Only when you supply a valid aria-labelledby pointing at an external <label> element does hideLabel truly suppress the built-in label. In contrast, hideLabel={false} will render the built-in label above the toggle as you’d expect.
